title: CLCON/105/2003 of KARAN SINGH Vs H.P.VERMA

paras.text:
CLCON No. 105/03
Hon'ble M.M. Ghildiyal, J.
C.M. Application 7060/04:
 Heard Sri Abdul Wahid, learned counsel for
the petitioner and Smt. Beena Pandey, learned
Standing Counsel for the State of U.P.
 The Division Bench of this Court on
02.04.2003 in writ petition no. 236 (S/B) 2003 Karan
Singh Vs. State and others passed order directing the
respondent's authority to decide the representation of
the petitioner (contained in annexure 6 to the writ
petition) within a period of four weeks from the date
of production of the order.
 This Contempt Petition was filed by the
petitioner stating therein that the respondent has not
complied with the order passed by this Court on
02.04.2003 and, as such, he may be punished for the
contempt of Court.
 A supplementary counter affidavit has been
field by the respondents, alongwith which they have
annexed a copy of the order dated 31st August 2004,
passed by the Executive Engineer by which the
representation of the petitioner has been rejected.
 Since the order passed by this Court has been
complied with by deciding the representation of the
petitioner, hence the Contempt Petition has become
infructuous and is dismissed as such.
 The notices issued earlier in the matter shall
stand discharged.
(M.M. Ghildiyal, J.)
15.12.2004
